description: NaFeF₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.82 Å. Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-38°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.99 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Fe atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one Fe atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Fe atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two equivalent Fe atoms.
